learner_data.note: Operations touching learner PII are refused until the learner vault/tokenization boundary lands. users/self is the educator's own profile and is not learner data. Substrings were extended in the wave-3 hardening to cover every learner-bearing path the lane-8 gap scan found (students, search_users, recent_students, bulk_user_tags, gradeable_students, moderated_students, provisional_grades, custom_gradebook_columns, rubric_assessments, peer_reviews, bulk_user_progress, outcome_results, anonymous submissions, collaborations, conferences, audits, what-if grades, test-student reads, content-share users, submission summaries).
learner_data.url_segments_note: Structural rule: a URL path segment (placeholders such as {id} ignored) equal to an entry in url_segments, or ending with an entry in url_segment_suffixes, names a resource whose response carries people: user objects, student ids, or per-student data. It catches endpoints no substring anticipated (potential_collaborators, activity_stream, effective_due_dates, assignment overrides, page revisions). url_substrings stay as a second net. Course content (pages, quizzes, assignments, modules) is deliberately not matched: projecting it would rewrite names inside content an educator may save back.

never_dispatch.note: These operations are never dispatchable through the installed product, for any caller, even with educator approval. They are the standing exclusions (proof directive 2026-09-20) and the catalog's excluded set.
